name: DataSet
summary: Record-oriented CRUD presentation: a toolbar, a selectable grid and a caller-rendered form.

props.name: label
props.meaning: Accessible name of the dataset region.

props.name: locale
props.meaning: Language of the toolbar and selection labels.

props.name: mode
props.meaning: Caller-owned view; keep it in the URL when it identifies the page state.

props.name: rows
props.meaning: Records of the current page, already authorized by the API.

props.name: columns
props.meaning: Grid columns with a stable key, header and cell renderer.

props.name: rowId / rowName
props.meaning: Stable record identity and the name used in the selection label.

props.name: selectedId / onSelect
props.meaning: Caller-owned selection; double-clicking a row selects it and requests form mode.

props.name: onModeChange, onAdd, onPrevious, onNext, onDuplicate, onRefresh
props.meaning: Toolbar actions; an omitted handler disables its button, for example at the first record or while a draft is unsaved.

props.name: onDelete
props.meaning: Omit when the records cannot be deleted; null shows the action disabled.

props.name: refreshing
props.meaning: Marks the refresh action busy while the caller reloads data. Defaults to false.

props.name: empty
props.meaning: Grid content when there are no rows.

props.name: children
props.meaning: The current record's form, rendered only in form mode.

accessibility: The toolbar uses role=toolbar with labeled icon buttons and tooltips. Rows are selected through labeled native radio buttons, so keyboard selection works without pointer gestures; links and buttons inside cells keep their own behavior.
usage: Keep records, selection, mode, API calls, permissions and draft handling in the feature. Pass handlers only for actions the API supports and the person may perform, and withhold navigation handlers while a form has unsaved changes.

examples.label: Grid and form modes
examples.description: Synthetic local records; selection and mode are held by the example and no request is made.
